mapper.select:
SELECT S1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD , S1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_NM , S2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD , S2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_NM , S3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD , S3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_NM , C1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD , C1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_NM , C2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD , C2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_NM FROM (SELECT T1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE, T1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, T1.SRTNG_SQNCE FROM SAC100 T1 WHERE T1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND T1.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND EXISTS (SELECT X.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAC110 X /* 공통코드값 사용시스템 */ WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = T1.CMMNS_CD_ID AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND X.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD})
) S1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE, SRTNG_SQNCE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND USE_YN = 'Y') S2 ON S2.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE = S1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE LEFT JOIN (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE, SRTNG_SQNCE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND USE_YN = 'Y') S3 ON S3.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE = S2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE LEFT JOIN (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE, SRTNG_SQNCE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND USE_YN = 'Y') C1 ON C1.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN(S1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE, S2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE, S3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE, SRTNG_SQNCE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND USE_YN = 'Y') C2 ON C2.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE WHERE 1 = 1
AND NVL(S1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,'X') LIKE #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} || '%'
AND NVL(S2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,'X') LIKE #{PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD} || '%'
AND NVL(S3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,'X') LIKE #{PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD} || '%'
AND NVL(C1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,'X') LIKE #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} || '%'
AND NVL(C2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,'X') LIKE #{PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD} || '%'
ORDER BY S1.SRTNG_SQNCE, S2.SRTNG_SQNCE, S3.SRTNG_SQNCE, C1.SRTNG_SQNCE, C2.SRTNG_SQNCE
